declarations.name: Poincare.ParabolicGraphTimeJets.finite_time_transfer
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (E : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
(ι : Type v) [Fintype ι] (α T : ℝ)
(G : Poincare.ParabolicSolutionGraph.Graph (E := E) α T)
(W : ι → Poincare.ParabolicSolutionGraph.Graph (E := E) α T)
(a : ι → ℝ) (x : E) (xs : ι → E), 0 < T →
(∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, G.u (s,x) = ∑ i, a i * (W i).u (s,xs i)) →
∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, G.ut (t,x) = ∑ i, a i * (W i).ut (t,xs i)
